verdict.rationale: Logseq has no documented first-party AI/LLM connector, but its open plugin marketplace (617 registered packages), local HTTP API for external graph access, and logseq:// protocol for third-party app integration provide an ecosystem pathway for AI plugins/tools to connect to notes. Community evidence confirms some users did integrate LLMs like Claude/codex to write/update pages, but also that this broke in the newer DB version, showing fragility rather than a robust first-party AI integration story. Missing for 10: an official AI/LLM connector or documented AI plugin category, first-party docs mentioning LLM integration, and confirmation that AI plugin workflows are stable across versions.
